guidance: Again, as announced earlier, the progress on the new resourcing outsourcing project that we had announced last year is quite good, and we expect the commer cial sales under this project to commence sometime in quarter 3
The first project is relatively small, but it is at a fairly advanced s tage of development, and we expect the commercial sale to also start somewhere in financial year '27, '28.
capex: And similarly, China brownfield expansion where we are creating capacities for manufacturing of steel Cages for i ndustrial and auto sector, that should commence production somewhere in quarter 3 FY 2028.
We have incurred capex of INR35.6 crores in the last quarter.
risks: Having said that, because we are seeing a lot of cost-related challenges, it's very difficult to fully clearly answer this question.
And right now, we see a pretty decent growth, but then obviousl y, there are certain headwinds and challenges as a market, bearing market and as well as what we face.
focus: We believe that new products that we are also in a process of developing this segment, the target annual sales again in this segment should reach about INR300 crores over the next four years.
However, we will continue to focus on increasing the sales of finished Cages out of our Romania facility.

However, as and when our new capacity comes online, which brings in new portfolio of product that will accelerate the growth there on basis of new introduction of new production, new products and so on.

about: Incorporated in 2010, Harsha Engineers Ltd is a leading engineering company that offers a diversified suite of products across geographies and end-user industries. It manufactures brass, steel, and polyamide cages and stamped components with production facilities located in Asia (India & China) and in Europe (Romania). [1]
